lede: St. Louis had last change, so Jim Montgomery picked most of these matchups. St. Louis played without Ross Johnston and Dylan Peterson. Vegas played without Mitch Marner.

notes.head: Thomas’s line drew Eichel’s line
notes.text: Jim Montgomery sent Holloway, Thomas and Snuggerud out for 14:41 of their 16:57 at 5-on-5 against Barbashev, Eichel and Stone (87%, about 29% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.34 to 0.79 expected goals. St. Louis scored one of its six goals then.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Dowd’s line
notes.text: Kaskimäki, Suter and Stenberg spent 8:09 of their 11:48 at 5-on-5 against Gatcomb, Dowd and Lavoie (69%, about 20% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.45 to 0.25 expected goals. St. Louis scored one of its six goals then.

notes.head: The third line drew Howden’s line
notes.text: McMichael, McTavish and Berggren spent 8:24 of their 12:26 at 5-on-5 against Howden, Karlsson and Holtz (68%, about 26% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.34 to 0.94 expected goals. St. Louis scored one of its six goals then.

foot: Jim Montgomery matched harder than in his other home games: each line spent 71% of its time against one opposing line, against 36% to 46% in his first three.
